purpose: FRONTERA supplier discovery pipeline. Entries are research leads only; listing a supplier here does not mean FRONTERA has applied, been approved, or has permission to use product feeds or affiliate links.

suppliers.name: Sea to Summit
evidence_notes: Official affiliate page states 10% commission and 30-day cookie.
Official affiliate page directs applicants to AvantLink.
Product range includes sleeping systems, tents and tarps, cookware, dry bags, water storage and water-sports accessories.
suppliers.next_action: After AvantLink publisher account verification, inspect merchant terms and apply if suitable.

suppliers.name: UCO Gear
evidence_notes: Official affiliate page advertises 10% base commissions.
Official affiliate page describes lighting, fire-starting and camp-kitchen gear.
Official affiliate page links to AvantLink publisher signup.
suppliers.next_action: After AvantLink publisher account verification, inspect merchant terms and apply if suitable.

suppliers.name: Naturehike
evidence_notes: Official affiliate page says applications are through Impact and identifies program ID 7562141.
Official page describes tents, four-season tents, sleeping bags, pads, cookware, stoves, packs and trekking poles.
Program terms and product-feed availability must be checked inside the partner account.
suppliers.next_action: Review Impact signup and program terms; do not import until approved and feed access is confirmed.

suppliers.name: Timber Ridge
evidence_notes: Awin merchant profile identifies program 131409 and a 30-day attribution period.
Awin profile describes folding chairs, tents, shelters, coolers and gear bags.
Product-feed access and current program terms require confirmation in FRONTERA's Awin account.
suppliers.next_action: Check whether FRONTERA can apply from its existing Awin publisher account and inspect feed availability.

suppliers.name: OUTFITR (US)
evidence_notes: Awin merchant profile identifies program 117613 and a 30-day attribution period.
Awin profile promotes backpacks and camping equipment.
The profile text contains inconsistent commission claims (10% in the summary and 15% in the body); verify directly in Awin before applying.
Brand and product quality require additional due diligence before FRONTERA promotes products.
suppliers.next_action: Hold for additional merchant and brand due diligence; do not prioritize until claims and product quality are verified.

import_rules: Do not import products from a supplier until FRONTERA is approved and the applicable feed or permitted product source is confirmed.
Do not treat affiliate program existence as evidence of product quality or technical suitability.
Keep retail facts, network approval status, feed access and FRONTERA fit verification as separate fields.
Only manufacturer-verified specifications may support trip-planner suitability claims.
Recheck commission, attribution, permitted traffic sources, brand bidding restrictions, feed terms and program status inside the live network account before activation.
